question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb **"tells" **is in the present tense, matching the habitual action described in the passage.
 
• A present tense verb is appropriate here to denote a routine or habitual action (**"tells the fortunes of so many people").**
 
• The use of **"tells" **emphasizes the regularity of the fortune teller's actions, contrasting with his inability to foresee his own crisis.
 
• In the customer's comment, **"Every day he tells..."** correctly parallels the habitual nature of the fortune teller's work.
 
• This choice maintains consistency with the narrative and logical flow of the passage.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (tell): "Tell"** is the base form of the verb and does not fit the structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2 (telling):** **"Telling"** is a present participle and does not make sense in the context of a habitual action.
 
• **Option 3 (told):** **"Told"** is in the past tense and does not match the present habitual action described.
